files.title: Image URLs
files.description: Direct links to the images to upscale (JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, TIFF, SVG).

scale.title: Scale
scale.description: 4× runs Real-ESRGAN directly. 2× is the 4× result reduced with a sharp filter (crisper than plain resizing). Inputs up to 2 MP for 4×, 4 MP for 2×.

format.title: Output format
format.description: PNG is lossless and keeps transparency. JPG and WebP are much smaller.

maxFileSizeMb.title: Max file size (MB)
maxFileSizeMb.description: Larger files are skipped with an error (not charged).
